name: DynamicButter
description: Frame-accurate macros and the Dynamic click-window trainer.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode
safe-mode.description: An attempt that used macro playback or a speedhack other than 1.0x doesn't save progress: no new best, completion, stars, orbs, coins or leaderboard entry. Turn off at your own risk.

dynamic-enabled.name: Dynamic
dynamic-enabled.description: The Dynamic trainer: the window scan (and later the click assist). Turn off to use DynamicButter purely as a macro bot: the Dynamic button disappears and nothing Dynamic runs.

dynamic-leniency.name: Dynamic leniency
dynamic-leniency.description: How many physics steps (1/240 s each) before a click's window Dynamic still accepts it: such a click is held and happens on the first step of the window. Earlier clicks, late clicks and clicks without a scanned window go through unchanged.

dynamic-scan-range.name: Dynamic scan range
dynamic-scan-range.description: How many physics steps (1/240 s each) earlier and later the window scan tests every click. Larger finds wider windows but takes longer.

smart-startpos.name: SmartStartPos
smart-startpos.description: Start positions take their speed, gamemode, size, gravity, dual and mirror from the last portals before them. Speed portals with preview turned off are ignored; a portal the start position is inside isn't forced (it applies itself on spawn).

macro-mode.name: Macro mode
macro-mode.description: Also set from the DB button in the pause menu. Record: records your inputs and saves a .gdr2 file to the mod's macros folder when you complete the level. Playback: replays the macro picked in the DB popup, or the newest one recorded on this level, and ignores your own clicks. Dynamic: you play, and a click up to 'Dynamic leniency' steps before its window (from the window scan) is held until the window opens. Takes effect at the start of the next attempt (restart after changing it).

speedhack-enabled.name: Speedhack enabled
speedhack-enabled.description: Turns the speedhack on or off. Also in the pause-menu DB popup, and on the speedhack hotkey.

speedhack-key.name: Speedhack hotkey
speedhack-key.description: Turns the speedhack on or off while playing.

speedhack.name: Speedhack
speedhack.description: Game speed while in a level (1.0 = normal), music included, when the speedhack is enabled. Useful for recording hard levels slowly: macros are timed by tick, so they replay identically at 1.0. Attempts at any speed other than 1.0 don't save progress while safe mode is on.

checkpoint-test.name: Checkpoint test (debug)
checkpoint-test.description: During Playback in practice mode: every 2.5 s, places a checkpoint, respawns at it after 0.5 s, and logs whether the replay matches the original run exactly.

physics-correction.name: Physics correction
physics-correction.description: During playback, snaps the player to the recorded position, rotation and y-velocity at every input. Turn off to test pure frame-accuracy. Drift is logged either way.

show-tick-counter.name: Show tick counter
show-tick-counter.description: Shows the current physics tick (240 per second) in the top-left corner while playing.

log-inputs.name: Log inputs
log-inputs.description: Debug: logs every input GD applies, with its tick and player position.

tick-probe.name: Tick probe
tick-probe.description: Debug: logs once per second whether the tick counter advances exactly once per physics step.

physics-trace.name: Physics trace (debug)
physics-trace.description: Logging only: writes the player state at every physics step, plus inputs, orbs/pads/triggers/pickups, deaths and completions, to a CSV file per level in the mod's traces folder. The header lists the level's start settings and legacy physics options. Nothing is written during a Dynamic scan or a seek. Files are large (about 240 lines per second of play).

force-disable-cbs.name: Force-disable Click Between Steps
force-disable-cbs.description: Debug: keeps Click Between Steps off while playing, without changing your saved GD setting. Recording always does this on its own.
